description: The plateau of terrains/cliffs.lua alone. Strata now move ground along the slope, so they show on the faces and leave the plateau alone: slope p90 1.6 degrees and 24 m of relief per km (7.2 degrees and 59 m while strata were a terrace of height plus a tilted plane, which striped it), and it drains (no closed depressions over a hundredth of a percent).
